entry.summary: An Australian territory: Australian citizens flying from the mainland need photo ID, not a passport; arriving from an international port, a passport.

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: January, March and April. Driest: June, July and August. Hottest: April (26.4°C average). Coolest: August (24.7°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.
